policy: Every edge is under review and internal only. Relations are source-attributed summaries of general physiology across selected endocrine networks, not an exhaustive pathway database. Symbolic Human Design features are not nodes in this biological network. Do not expose catalog entries in readings until appropriate domain review approves the exact claim and use.
